testcase.name: Scenario: Open the file menu while a part is active: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-file-menu-source/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open the file menu while a part is active ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user selects File ✔ Then a menu opens with New, Open, Save, Save As, Export, Print and Close entries ✔ And the menu also shows Share, Manage and document properties entries ✔ And the command entries form a vertical list on the left ✔ And a recent-documents region is visible to the right of that list ✔ And some commands show disclosure indicators ✔ And application options and an exit control appear at the bottom of the menu ✔ And the model workspace remains visible behind the menu
